description: This file defines the HdcpProfile class, which implements plugin and JSONRPC interfaces for managing HDCP (High-bandwidth Digital Content Protection) status and HDMI hot plug events within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It declares methods for initialization, event handling, and status querying.

classes.name: HdcpProfile
classes.description: A plugin class managing HDCP status and HDMI events, inheriting from PluginHost::IPlugin and PluginHost::JSONRPC, with methods for initialization, event handling, and communication.

methods.name: getHDCPStatusWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to retrieve HDCP status, parsing input parameters and outputting a response.

methods.name: getSettopHDCPSupportWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to query support for HDCP by the set-top.

methods.name: getHDCPStatus
methods.description: Returns current HDCP status as a JsonObject.

methods.name: onHdmiOutputHotPlug
methods.description: Handles HDMI hot plug events based on connection status.

methods.name: onHdmiOutputHDCPStatusEvent
methods.description: Handles HDMI HDCP status change events.

methods.name: logHdcpStatus
methods.description: Logs current HDCP status with context.

methods.name: dsHdmiEventHandler
methods.description: Static callback for HDMI-related IARM events.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell.
